desc.zh: 从资金门槛推导最大利润选择，用排序与堆避免重复扫描。
desc.en: Derive the affordable-profit greedy rule, then replace repeated scans with sorting and a heap.

complexity: O(n log n + min(k,n) log n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Affordable profit dominance
concepts.description: Exchange the first choice without losing any later feasible project.

concepts.name: Sorted capital frontier and max heap
concepts.description: Admit each project once; extract the largest affordable profit.
